basis: FICTIONAL — invented to mirror the real registry's shape for tests. No real effort, person or channel appears here.
definition: A storyline is a body of WORK: a named effort with a goal, that spans conversations and days. It is not a person, not a team, not a channel, not a meeting series, and not a shape of request.

anti_storylines.why_tempting: One person appears in every thread, so their name reads like a project.
anti_storylines.why_wrong: A person is not an effort. Filing by who wrote it buries the work under a contact card.
anti_storylines.detect_with: A candidate title that is a person's name, or a name plus a generic noun.

signature.note: Matched against the app's own cluster titles, which is all the scorer has to go on.

storylines.title: River office lease
storylines.charter: Signing and fitting out the second-floor suite on River Street: the lease itself, the addendum, the fit-out allowance, the sprinkler work, and the keys. Ends when the suite is occupied.
includes: the addendum and its allowance clause
the walkthrough that settles the fit-out
excludes: the surveyor's report on the north elevation, which belongs to the building, not the lease

members.note: A one-question spur off the same negotiation.

storylines.charter: Rebuilding the studio's public site: the content audit, the new templates, the photography, and the launch. Ends at launch.
